results.title: Maribor Art Gallery - Christoph Grill / Depth of field / exhibition opening
results.description: You are warmly invited to the opening of the exhibition by Graz-based photographer Christoph Grill at UGM Kabinet, taking place on Friday, 16 January 2026, at 19:00. With the exhibition Depth of Field, the Graz-based photographer Christoph Grill is returning to Maribor after almost twenty years.

highlights:
[16. 1. 2026 Christoph Grill / Depth of field / exhibition opening]

**Christoph Grill / Depth of field**
**UGM Kabinet, Strossmayerjeva ulica 6**
**Friday, 16 January 2026, 19:00**

…

With the exhibition Depth of Field, the Graz-based photographer Christoph Grill is returning to Maribor after almost twenty years. The exhibition continues the collaboration with the Photon Gallery (Ljubljana/Maribor) and the artistic exchange with Graz (Austria), an important cultural center in the immediate vicinity of Maribor.
